_comment: Ionix — the base theme. ionix-quickshell already ships this palette in
config/Theme.qml, so there is deliberately nothing to override here.
This file is symlinked to ~/.config/quickshell/ionix/theme.json. Keeping it
present-but-empty means switching back to 'ionix' actively clears whatever the
previous theme installed, rather than relying on its uninstall having run.
The user's own ~/.config/quickshell/ionix/config.json is merged on top of this
file, so nothing here can clobber their personal overrides.
